bio.text: Steve Womack has represented Arkansas's Third District since he was elected in 2010 and chairs the Appropriations Subcommittee on Transportation, Housing and Urban Development.
He formerly served as Mayor of Rogers and as Chairman of the House Budget Committee.
He retired from the Arkansas Army National Guard in 2009 as a Colonel after more than thirty years of service.
He is a graduate of Arkansas Tech University and lives in Rogers.
